profile_text.body:
Perplexity is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. On its own site the company describes Perplexity as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question. Its tracked products are Perplexity AI, described as a search-augmented LLM, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise search product whose noted features include internal knowledge search, data indexing, SSO, and audit logs.

The company also appears in the MCP registry through two servers: ai.perplexity/mcp-server, described as offering real-time web search, reasoning, and research through Perplexity's API, and ai.smithery/arjunkmrm-perplexity-search, described as enabling AI assistants to perform web searches using Perplexity's Sonar Pro.

Perplexity is a party to a number of tracked lawsuits. These include Gagleard v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California and in the District Court, E.D. California; Cable News Network Inc v. Perplexity AI, Inc., The New York Times Company v. Perplexity AI, Inc., Chicago Tribune Company, LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc., and Encyclopaedia Britannica, Inc. v. Perplexity AI, Inc., all in the District Court, S.D. New York; Noel v. Perplexity AI, Inc. and Amazon.com Services LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Amazon.com Services, LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. A legal exposure tally for the company lists California with a count of 281.
